name: reconnection-after-conflict
description:
Provides post-conflict repair sequences with conversation timing guidance, trust rebuilding steps, and incremental reconnection strategies. Produces structured reconnection plans with specific scripts for re-engagement after arguments or periods of distance.
Use when the user wants to reconnect after a fight, rebuild after a period of emotional distance, or repair a relationship after a significant disagreement.
Do NOT use for reconciliation after separation, assessing whether to continue a relationship, or replacing couples therapy.
